svg.title: OPAL user flow map
svg.desc: Swimlane flow from the data standard, through planning, offline data collection and sync, to post-processing and model training.
svg.text: From standard to trained model, in one system
Every hand-off that used to go through the spreadsheet now happens inside OPAL, including the ones made offline.
Saved offline first, then queued for sync
Outside OPAL: the app can't connect to the customer's machine
